Design: game-only HUD showing weapon, dash charges, style rank, controls and handshake state. Camera sourced from PlayerController.cameraGameObjectLocal, not a separate gameplay scene. Optional local file bridge only with ULTRAHAUL_DEV=1; excluded from release activation. HUD placed below native health/stamina and scales with display height. Runtime checks select only active, living native enemies; disabled/despawned enemies are excluded. Development menu transitions only end a tutorial when the native current run is a tutorial. Enemy test placement and aim retain the same living target to avoid accidentally aiming at another enemy. Slam isolation uses a real airborne controller drop with native crouch input, in a point with clear vertical headroom; this tests the slam separately from jump setup. Controlled combat checks spawn the native Hunter setup and select its Huntsman enemy, separately from other procedural enemies.
